description: This file defines the 'Thing' interface in the Eclipse Ditto project, representing a generic entity with attributes, features, lifecycle, access control, and policies. It includes method signatures for manipulating these properties and nested classes for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: Thing.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains definitions of JSON fields used in serialization/deserialization of Thing objects, including schema version, lifecycle, namespace, revision, timestamps, ID, ACL, policy ID, definition, attributes, features, and metadata.

methods.name: Thing.newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing a Thing from scratch.

methods.name: Thing.toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with the current Thing's data for modifications.

methods.name: Thing.getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace derived from the Thing's ID.

methods.name: Thing.getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes of the Thing.

methods.name: Thing.setAttributes
methods.description: Sets attributes on a copy of the Thing.

methods.name: Thing.removeAttributes
methods.description: Removes all attributes from a copy of the Thing.

methods.name: Thing.getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID of the Thing.

methods.name: Thing.setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a specific attribute at the given path with a JsonValue.

methods.name: Thing.removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes the attribute at the specified path.

methods.name: Thing.getDefinition
methods.description: Returns the Thing's definition.

methods.name: Thing.setDefinition
methods.description: Sets the Thing's definition by identifier.

methods.name: Thing.removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes the Thing's definition.

methods.name: Thing.setFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Sets the definition for a specific feature.

methods.name: Thing.removeFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Removes the definition from a feature.

methods.name: Thing.setFeatureProperties
methods.description: Sets properties for a specific feature.

methods.name: Thing.setFeatureProperty
methods.description: Sets a property within a feature at the specified path.

methods.name: Thing.removeFeatureProperties
methods.description: Removes all properties from a feature.

methods.name: Thing.removeFeatureProperty
methods.description: Removes a specific property from a feature.

methods.name: Thing.getLifecycle
methods.description: Returns the current lifecycle of the Thing.

methods.name: Thing.setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets the lifecycle of the Thing.

methods.name: Thing.hasLifecycle
methods.description: Checks if the Thing has a specific lifecycle.

methods.name: Thing.getAccessControlList
methods.description: Returns the ACL of the Thing.

methods.name: Thing.setAccessControlList
methods.description: Sets the ACL for the Thing.

methods.name: Thing.setAclEntry
methods.description: Sets an ACL entry, overwriting existing entries for the same subject.

methods.name: Thing.removeAllPermissionsOf
methods.description: Removes all permissions associated with a given authorization subject.

methods.name: Thing.getPolicyId
methods.description: Returns the deprecated Policy ID as a string.

methods.name: Thing.setPolicyId
methods.description: Sets the deprecated Policy ID from a string.

methods.name: Thing.getPolicyEntityId
methods.description: Returns the typed PolicyId object.

methods.name: Thing.getFeatures
methods.description: Returns the features of the Thing.

methods.name: Thing.setFeatures
methods.description: Sets features on a copy of the Thing.

methods.name: Thing.removeFeatures
methods.description: Removes all features.

methods.name: Thing.setFeature
methods.description: Sets a feature, replacing if it exists.

methods.name: Thing.removeFeature
methods.description: Removes a feature by ID.

methods.name: Thing.validate
methods.description: A deprecated method that no longer performs validation.
